answer: A sybil defense can require endorsements from several unconnected peer clusters. A newcomer must earn backing from reef builders, shale miners, and canyon surveyors who rarely interact, so a puppet farm cannot vouch for itself: forging one fake cluster is cheap, but forging ties across independent groups costs real work, reputation, and time. If a cluster is caught endorsing fakes, its own standing is cut, so honest groups audit newcomers carefully. The limit is collusion across clusters, so endorsement diversity is sampled randomly.
